the mechanisms by which extracellular ATP regulates thyroid function.
the mechanism of action of ATP on FRTL-5 thyroid cells, in which ATP is a potent secretagogue of iodide, a precursor of thyroid hormone.
the mechanism of action of ATP in FRTL- 5 cells.

the activation of P2-purinoceptors in thyroid cells is coupled to PLC, PLA2, and PKC activation and that the increase of [Ca2+] and PKC are not involved in PLA2 activation.

The main takeaway from our work is that
P2-purine receptor stimulation in FRTL- 5 thyroid cells leads to a complex series of intracellular events, some of which are independent of each other.
P2-purinoceptors are able to stimulate the release of AA and 125I from FRTL-5 thyroid cells through parallel activation of PLC, PLA2, and PKC, but not through sequential activation.
